support.faq_q1: How is my data stored and protected?
support.faq_a1: All your health records are encrypted with AES-256 and stored on servers in Germany, fully compliant with DSGVO (GDPR). Only you can access your data. You can export or delete all your data at any time from account settings.
support.faq_q2: How do I add a second child to my account?
support.faq_a2: Tap the '+' button next to your child tabs in the header. Enter your child's name, date of birth, gender and blood group.
support.faq_q3: Can I share records with my child's doctor?
support.faq_a3: Yes — open any health record and tap the Download button to save it as a PDF. You can then share it via email, WhatsApp or print it.
support.faq_a4: Yes. PediVault uses the official STIKO 2026 immunisation schedule published by the Robert Koch Institute (RKI).
support.faq_a5: U-Untersuchungen are Germany's statutory paediatric check-ups (U1 through U9) covered by all Krankenkassen at no cost.
support.faq_q6: How does the AI Assistant work?
support.faq_a6: The AI Assistant is powered by Claude (Anthropic) and has access to your child's health context. It is not a substitute for medical advice.
support.faq_q7: How do I update my child's growth measurements?
support.faq_a7: Go to the Growth module and tap 'Add Entry'. Enter the date, weight, height and head circumference.
support.faq_q8: What should I do if I find an error in my records?
support.faq_a8: Tap 'Contact Support' below and describe the issue.
support.stillQuestionsSub2: or use the Send Feedback form below.
